comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
These eggs are obtainable upon a failure on a transmutation/transformation attempt with alchemy (chance roughly 20-25 %) and it gives the following as far as I know (one of them randomly):
20x Seal of Sorcery
20x Seal of Undine
20x Seal of Salamander
20x Seal of Sylph
20x Seal of Gnome

They can be handy in case you need more solutions for experiments or this one ^^
